description: The agent must: (1) Run `node scripts/create-wallet.js --json` (or `--env`) to generate a new wallet and capture the address and private key. (2) Read task_spec.json to extract the nonce ('aB3xK9mN2pQr7vWz'), domain ('agentplatform.local'), URI ('https://agentplatform.local/register'), and statement. (3) Construct a SIWE-formatted message following the exact EIP-4361 format from SKILL.md — critically including 'Chain ID: 8453' (Base Mainnet, NOT Ethereum mainnet chain ID 1). The message must include the agent's address, the domain wanting sign-in, the URI, Version: 1, the provided nonce, and an Issued At timestamp. (4) Sign the SIWE message using `ethers.Wallet` loaded from the private key via `wallet.signMessage(message)`. (5) Write agent_registration.json containing all four required fields: agent_address, siwe_message, siwe_signature, and registered_at. The proprietary trap is the Chain ID: agents using pre-training knowledge default to Ethereum mainnet (chain ID 1), but the SKILL.md explicitly shows Base Mainnet as chain ID 8453, and the platform config files reinforce this. The SIWE message format must also be exact per the EIP-4361 template shown in SKILL.md.
